profile.headline: Graphic Designer | Adobe Creative Suite Expert | eCommerce & Packaging Design | Video Editing | Remote Work | GA-Based
profile.summary:
Graphic Designer specializing in eCommerce and consumer goods branding with 1+ years of professional experience creating compelling visual content across digital and print channels.

🎨 Core Expertise:
• Digital Marketing Assets: Social media graphics, display ads, email templates, website visuals
• Packaging Design: Brand-aligned product packaging for consumer goods
• Video Editing: Multi-channel video content for marketing campaigns
• Product Photography: Lifestyle and product imagery optimized for online retail

💻 Technical Skills:
• Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (Expert Level)
• Video: After Effects, Premiere Pro
• Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, and web design best practices

🛒 eCommerce Platform Experience:
• Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Temu, Etsy
• Creating optimized product listings and lifestyle imagery for online retail

✨ Work Style:
• Collaborative team player across marketing, product, and eCommerce departments
• Thrives in fast-paced environments managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Flexible and detail-oriented, ensuring brand consistency across all deliverables
• Experienced with remote work and adaptable scheduling

📍 Based in Georgia (GA) | Available for fully remote, part-time opportunities

positions.title: Purchasing / Sales Support
positions.description:
Duties and Responsibilities
- Participates in the procurement of electronic components and computer hardware products. Keeps abreast of product information.
- Communicates and determines scheduling with suppliers for pricing, order fulfillment and delivery. Resolves problems.
- Researches purchasing and sales statistics in order to analyze and establish client needs.
- Reviews and evaluates quotes. Researches, identifies and recommends potential suppliers. Issues
purchase requisitions within authorized limits and schedules deliveries. Follows up on orders.
- Records ordering information, issues purchase requisitions to suppliers, and complies with Abacus
purchasing procedures to obtain purchase order numbers. Keeps accurate records.
- Expedites open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery.
- Works with buyers of house accounts to supply parts while providing great customer service.
